title: Sync beads to a private DoltHub database
description: Chowderr added (2026-10-06): allowed domains doltremoteapi.dolthub.com + www.dolthub.com; env vars DOLTHUB_API_TOKEN, DOLT_CREDS_KEY_ID (7bsfgmf398656v6ker1bhr1thneo2u1ha6d3gk30ilrbg), DOLT_CREDS_JWK; setup-script line writing ~/.dolt/creds/$DOLT_CREDS_KEY_ID.jwk and ~/.dolt/config_global.json. Steps in a NEW cloud session: (1) confirm the env vars and ~/.dolt/creds exist and DoltHub answers; (2) create private DoltHub DB chowderr/<beads db name> via POST https://www.dolthub.com/api/v1alpha1/database with header "authorization: token $DOLTHUB_API_TOKEN" (ownerName chowderr, visibility private); (3) bd dolt remote remove origin; bd dolt remote add origin chowderr/<db>; bd dolt push; first check that bd embedded Dolt reads ~/.dolt/creds; (4) verify issue count matches via the DoltHub SQL API; (5) only then: git rm --cached .beads/issues.jsonl, add it to the ROOT .gitignore, keep export.auto true and export.git-add false, update the README tracking section, commit to main. Per the vault notes reference_dolthub_account_and_api + reference_beads_jsonl_untrack_fix.
notes:
2026-10-06 cloud session: STOPPED at step 1. The session egress proxy refuses CONNECT to doltremoteapi.dolthub.com:443 and www.dolthub.com:443 (HTTP 403, connect_rejected), so no DoltHub DB was created and nothing was pushed. Env vars DOLTHUB_API_TOKEN, DOLT_CREDS_KEY_ID, DOLT_CREDS_JWK are set; ~/.dolt/creds/<key>.jwk was missing (setup script did not write it) and was written by hand along with ~/.dolt/config_global.json. Also: DOLT_CREDS_KEY_ID in the env (52 chars) is not the 45-char id written in this description; check which matches the public key registered on DoltHub. Needed: add both hosts to the environment's Allowed domains (Network access > Custom) and start a new session. .beads/issues.jsonl stays git-tracked.
2026-10-06 cloud session #2: STOPPED at step 1 again. Env vars are now correct (DOLTHUB_API_TOKEN 60 chars, DOLT_CREDS_KEY_ID 45 chars starting 7bsfgmf, DOLT_CREDS_JWK valid Ed25519 JWK); ~/.dolt/creds/<key>.jwk and ~/.dolt/config_global.json were written by hand (setup script still does not write them). But the session egress proxy still refuses CONNECT to doltremoteapi.dolthub.com:443 and www.dolthub.com:443 (HTTP 403, connect_rejected, "policy denial"), so no DoltHub DB was created and nothing was pushed. Needed: in the cloud environment settings (Edit > Network access), confirm the allowed-domain change was saved on the environment this session uses: either Custom with doltremoteapi.dolthub.com and www.dolthub.com listed (keep the default package-manager list), or Full access. Then start a new session. .beads/issues.jsonl stays git-tracked.
